premises.text: Joining huge enterprise tables on conventional database servers can take many hours, blocking iterative analytics
premises.evidence_span: it was taking our enterprise database server 35 hours to run

premises.text: BlazingDB is a GPU-based next-generation SQL database that massively parallelizes SQL for massive scale and hyper-fast queries
premises.evidence_span: next-generation SQL database on video graphics cards, or GPUs

premises.text: It deploys on cloud or configured on-prem rigs with interfaces and a workbench to connect code and analysts
premises.evidence_span: You can deploy it onto the cloud or an appropriately configured on-premise rig

premises.text: The system is fully distributed, self-configuring to hardware/data/usage, and SQL-accessible so businesses stay in SQL
premises.evidence_span: It is a fully distributed technology that splits the data and the computation across multiple servers

premises.text: A free-for-life community edition broadens access while enterprises run production clusters
premises.evidence_span: launching a community edition version of a GPU SQL database that is free to use for life

value.text: Enterprises get massive-scale hyper-fast SQL analytics on GPUs
value.evidence_span: unlocks that power for enterprises who need massive scale and hyper-fast SQL

causal_links.evidence_span: process millions of rows a second on your laptop

notes: Benchmark multiples vs Redshift/Postgres/MySQL treated as evidence of speed claim, not separate premises. Matrix-on-GPU insight folded into P2. Pilot/customer counts excluded as traction.
